paite: Kumpipa in TOUPA atu a, athupina in akithuam a; TOUPA ahatna a kithuam in atai ah akigakta hi; khovel leng alin theihlouhna ding in, hihkip in a-om hi.
heading: Pathian, Kumpipa
english: Yahweh reigns! He is clothed with majesty! Yahweh is armed with strength. The world also is established. It can’t be moved.

paite: Na laltutphah nidanglai a na hihkipsa ahi a, nang tangtawn a omsa na hi.
english: Your throne is established from long ago. You are from everlasting.

paite: TOUPA aw, luipite'n a-aw uh asuah ua, luipite'n aging thupitak uh asuah uhi.
english: The floods have lifted up, Yahweh, the floods have lifted up their voice. The floods lift up their waves.

paite: Tui tampi awte sang in, tuipi kihot hattakte sang in leng, tunglam a TOUPA ahatzaw hi.
english: Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, Yahweh on high is mighty.

paite: Na thu theihsakte amuanhuai mahmah a; TOUPA aw, tangtawn in na inn sianthouna toh akilawm hi.
english: Your statutes stand firm. Holiness adorns your house, Yahweh, forever more.
